text: Current situation
category: Topics to get the conversation started
followUp:
Usually the best way to start a conversation is to talk about your current situation. The questions you’ll ask vary greatly on where you are and what you are doing.

So for example, if you are waiting for something you might ask how long they’ve been waiting. Or if you are at a show or an event you might ask if they’ve seen the performer or speaker before. If you are traveling somewhere you might ask where the other person is headed. If you are at place that is serving food, talk about the food. If there is music playing, talk about the music.
sectionContext:
These are your run of the mill, first meeting someone, topics to talk about. Your ice breakers. You’ll find that most people will have at least some things to say about each of these topics.

Once you stumble upon something interesting or something they are interested in, keep talking about that for a while. Branch off from your initial topic and ask follow up questions about whatever they seem interested in. Usually people like talking about themselves, so it's usually good to focus on them and be a good listener with occasional prompting follow up questions.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Topics to talk about

text: What was the last funny video you saw?

text: What do you do to get rid of stress?

text: What is something you are obsessed with?

sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.

text: What three words best describe you?

text: What would be your perfect weekend?

text: What’s your favorite number? Why?

sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.

text: What are you going to do this weekend?

sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s the most useful thing you own?
followUp: Sure, this one is good for a general conversation starter, but what is really nice is being able to get some ideas on what works well and is generally awesome to have.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s your favorite way to waste time?

sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you think of tattoos? Do you have any?

sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you have any pets? What are their names?

sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.

text: Where did you go last weekend? / What did you do last weekend?
followUp: A pretty common conversation starter, but sometimes the best ones are the ones people are used to.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is something popular now that annoys you?
followUp: Time to channel some cranky old man vibes. Kids these days, with their stuff and their things and their hair. You know, that type of stuff.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What did you do on your last vacation?

sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: When was the last time you worked incredibly hard?
followUp: Whether it’s their job or a personal project, you can see what they put their heart and soul into.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Are you very active, or do you prefer to just relax in your free time?
followUp: Find out if they are all about the gym or all about the couch. To each their own!
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you do when you hang out with your friends?
followUp: See what they like to do when they are social, talk about that activity if you can.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Who is your oldest friend? Where did you meet them?
followUp: This is a great question because it often leads to some wonderful stories from when they were younger. I mean, who doesn’t like reminiscing about the good old days?
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s the best / worst thing about your work/school?
followUp: Tailor this question to the person you are talking to, whether they work, or they are a student. Also, some people like to let off steam, and some like to keep it positive so you can choose which way you want the question to swing.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: If you had intro music, what song would it be? Why?
followUp: This question can lead to a good conversation about their favorite song or the music they like.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What were you really into when you were a kid?
followUp: Every kid goes through phases when they are REALLY into one thing. Now you can find out what they obsessed about when they were a kid.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: If you could have any animal as a pet, what animal would you choose?
followUp: This one is fun because a blank check pet choice can lead to some great answers. And you can always transition the conversation into pets they had/have.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Have you ever saved an animal’s life? How about a person’s life?
followUp: Who doesn’t like listening to or telling a hero story? I’m sure it will lead to an interesting story. Even if it isn’t about them, and just about someone they know who saved an animal or person’s life.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: If you opened a business, what kind of business would it be?
followUp: This one can really be a huge conversation starter if the person you are talking to is in anyway entrepreneurial. It’s always fun to hear and discuss new business ideas. Don’t forget to ask for lots of details about their dream business.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Who is your favorite entertainer (comedian, musician, actor, etc.)?
followUp: Pop culture and entertainment are great topics for conversation, and this question is a good entry point into a larger conversation about what kind of entertainment they like.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Are you a very organized person?
followUp: Does everything have its place, or does their stuff roam about?
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Have you ever given a presentation in front of a large group of people? How did it go?
followUp: Public speaking is high up there on the biggest fears people have. So, I’m sure if they have, it probably left a big impression.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the strangest dream you have ever had?
followUp: Sure, talking about dreams can be dull, but who knows, if you are talking about the strangest dream they’ve EVER had, it might be pretty interesting. Or not. Let’s see!
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is a controversial opinion you have?
followUp: So, don’t immediately start bashing their opinion if you don’t like it. I mean, you asked the question after all. Let them explain why they have the opinion and their reasoning behind it. Not everyone has to have the same opinions as you. And if it’s super out there or evil, well it’s good to know so you can avoid them in the future.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Who in your life brings you the most joy?
followUp: An awesome question for keeping it positive, and they’ll be talking about someone they love, so it’ll be easy to jump into a conversation about whoever that person is and why they are so awesome.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Who had the biggest impact on the person you have become?
followUp: This one may or may not have the same answer as the previous question, so you might want to choose either this one or the previous one depending on the type of conversation you want to have.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the most annoying habit someone can have?
followUp: Find out what annoys them, chances are it probably annoys you too. Then it’s easy to step into a conversation about annoying habits.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Where is the most beautiful place you have been?
followUp: This one will probably lead to a good travel story. And conversations about travel are always fun.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Where do you spend most of your free time/day?
followUp: Find out what their day to day looks like. It’ll be easy to start up a conversation about anything of the things they do on the regular.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Who was your best friend in elementary school?
followUp: Time to get nostalgic about how life was when you both were growing up!
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How often do you stay up past 3 a.m.?
followUp: Are they a night owl or an early bird, time to find out! This can easily transition into a conversation about what they like to do in their free time.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s your favorite season? Why?
followUp: This question will probably conjure up some wonderful memories linked to your and their favorite season. Have fun reminiscing!
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Which is more important, having a great car or a great house? Why?
followUp: Do they care more about showing off to others or having awesome stuff for themselves? Always good to know! And you can easily transition into a conversation about cars you/they want or dream houses.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What animal or insect do you wish humans could eradicate?
followUp: Probably going to get a lot of mosquito answers. But depending on where you are and if they have a special hatred for a creature, you might get a different answer. If you get the mosquito answer, you could always talk about the best way to get rid of the evil pokey buzzing things.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Where is the most beautiful place near where you live?
followUp: Similar to the question about the most beautiful place they’ve seen but this time it’s local! Who knows, you might get a tip on an awesome local spot.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you bring with you everywhere you go?
followUp: Sure, you’ll get the normal keys, cellphone, purse/wallet, answers, but you might get to hear about a cool keepsake / lucky charm that means a lot to them.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How much time do you spend on the internet? What do you usually do?
followUp: Find out what sites they enjoy, chances are you probably enjoy some of the same sites. You can swap good people to follow or suggestions for interesting sites.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the most disgusting habit some people have?
followUp: An earlier question talked about annoying habits; now it’s time to get gross with it and find out what disgusts them.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Where and when was the most amazing sunset you have ever seen?
followUp: This one is another way to get into a good conversation about travel.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Which recent news story is the most interesting?
followUp: So, I had to make this one a bit vague, but it can lead to an interesting conversation about recent events. And you might just hear about something you didn’t know happened. Just make sure to steer clear of politics.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Where is the worst place you have been stuck for a long time?
followUp: Whether it’s at an airport, after a car broke down, or something else, we’ve all had times where we’ve had to wait for a seemingly endless amount of time. There is a good chance it’ll lead to a good story.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: If you had to change your name, what would your new name be?
followUp: This one is a little creative and fun. They might have to think about it for a bit, or they may have an answer right off. Don’t forget to ask them why and what might be a good last name as well.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is something that really annoys you but doesn’t bother most people?
followUp: Everybody likes sharing and complaining about what annoys them. Now you can find out what weird quirks annoy them.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What word or saying from the past do you think should come back?
followUp: There are all kinds of words and sayings from the past that have fallen out of use. It can be a lot of fun to dust them off and put them into modern sentences. If you both can’t think of any, there are plenty of lists online.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How should success be measured? And by that measurement, who is the most successful person you know?
followUp: This question can lead to some surprisingly deep answers. A lot of how we view the world is based on what we consider to be worthwhile, and this question tries to get at the heart of that to find out what is most important to the person.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is your guilty pleasure?
followUp: Everyone has something they absolutely love but might not be in line with how people view them or how they view themselves.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Was there ever an event in your life that defied explanation?
followUp: Time to learn about some cool mysteries! This one quite often leads to several good stories.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: If you could learn the answer to one question about your future, what would the question be?
followUp: A fun question that helps you figure out what is important to them.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Has anyone ever saved your life?
followUp: This one can get quite personal and sometimes tragic. So just a heads up, you might want to save this one for when you know the person well.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What benefit do you bring to the group when you hang out with friends?
followUp: Every member of a group has their duties. Time to find out what role they play! Plus, you can expand the conversation into what they usually do when they hang out with different groups of friends. And if you want more questions to ask friends, we've got 'em.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How often do you curse? And what’s your go-to string of curse words?
followUp: This question is definitely unique. You’ll have to judge the situation and who you are talking to in order to see if this question is a good fit for the situation. It can be fun, though.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What trends did you follow when you were younger?
followUp: Each generation has its trends. And if you are of a similar age, there is a good chance that you both share some similar trends that you followed.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you fear is hiding in the dark?
followUp: This is a great question to get into a conversation about fears that you both share.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What was the best period of your life so far? What do you think will be the best period of your entire life?
followUp: Another question that leads to a lot of fond memories and stories to tell, but also lets you know how hopeful of the future they are and what their ideal life would look like.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you do to improve your mood when you are in a bad mood?
followUp: Everyone needs to blow off steam sometimes. With this question, you can see if you share some stress relief techniques.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the silliest fear you have?
followUp: Another one about fear, but this one is more lighthearted. Everyone has fears that they know are irrational.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What are some things you want to accomplish before you die?
followUp: The classic bucket list question. It’s great because it shows you what they want out of life and what is most important to them. And it’s easy to split off into a conversation about any of the things they mention.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the best room in your house? Why?
followUp: Are the all about food and the kitchen? Perhaps they prefer to sleep or chill on the sofa? Or maybe there is a special reading nook they have. This is another question that helps get a conversation going about what they do in their downtime.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Who is someone popular now that you really like? Why do you like them so much?
followUp: This one serves as a great stepping stone into a conversation about celebrities and other people in the limelight.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Where is the best place to take a date?
followUp: This one you’ll have to be selective with, it’s not appropriate for all situations, but you might be able to get the low down on a good spot you didn’t know about. Just don’t let the conversation stray into their dating life, that can get a bit awkward. And if you need date ideas, we have 200!
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What smell brings back great memories?
followUp: Cookies at Christmas time, the smell of gas on a road trip, the salty air of the ocean. Smell has a strong link to memories and can be a great conversation starter.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What's the best pet name you can come up with for a specific type of pet?
followUp: Go for funny names, puns make great animal names. And you could tailor it for a pet that they have or would like to get.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How often do you help others? Who do you help? How do you help?
followUp: This is a great question to see how empathetic and prosocial they are. And can lead to conversations about volunteering or times they’ve helped others.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What are you best at?
followUp: With this one, you might learn about a hidden talent, or perhaps a hobby you didn’t know about. Both can be the beginning of an excellent conversation.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What makes you nervous?
followUp: Very similar to the fear one but a little bit broader. It can be something happening in their life right now, something that happens regularly, or something they think is likely to happen in the future.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Who is the funniest person you’ve met?
followUp: Not necessarily a comedian, but a friend or family member who always manages to make them laugh. It definitely could spin off into a conversation about comedians, though, which would also be fun.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What weird or useless talent do you have?
followUp: Wiggling ears, burping the alphabet, farting on command, humans are weird, and we all have some weird and useless talents that are fun to talk about.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What are some strange beliefs that some people have?
followUp: Be careful with this one, because they may end up labeling one of your beliefs as strange. Just be ready not to take their answer too personally.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Who would be the worst person to be stuck in an elevator with? How about the best person to be stuck in an elevator with?
followUp: Hypothetical questions can be a blast to talk about. And this is a fun one to ponder.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What was the best birthday wish or gift you've ever received?
followUp:
Hopefully, everyone has had a super thoughtful birthday wish or gift given to them. It’s a perfect question to get in a conversation about past birthdays.

For more random questions try our random questions to ask friends.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters that span all kinds of topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s the best sitcom past or present?
followUp: Chances are you probably binge-watched it as well, so it’s a great way to talk about a shared interest.
sectionContext: With so much great TV out there, it’s a great way to jump into a conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s the best show currently on TV?
followUp: Get ready for a lively debate, this is a golden age of TV, and everyone has their favorites.
sectionContext: With so much great TV out there, it’s a great way to jump into a conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What will be the future of TV shows?
followUp: There has been such a shakeup in the TV show marketplace that who knows what is coming next and where TV is headed. There is much speculation to be done!
sectionContext: With so much great TV out there, it’s a great way to jump into a conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How often do you binge watch shows?
followUp: They have, you have, we all have. But the real question is which ones and how often? Is it the same old show or something new each time? Perhaps you’ll even find your next binge-worthy show.
sectionContext: With so much great TV out there, it’s a great way to jump into a conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What cartoons did you watch as a child?
followUp: Even if you or the person you are talking to didn’t grow up in the age of Saturday morning cartoons, you both probably still have some beloved childhood cartoons.
sectionContext: With so much great TV out there, it’s a great way to jump into a conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s the funniest TV series you have seen?
followUp: Perfect for starting a conversation about a show you both are into, and if you haven’t watched the show they mention, you now have a new show to check out!
sectionContext: With so much great TV out there, it’s a great way to jump into a conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Which TV show do you want your life to be like?
followUp: I think secretly everyone wants to inhabit one of their favorite shows. Or maybe it’s just me. Just don’t forget to ask them why and get lots of details.
sectionContext: With so much great TV out there, it’s a great way to jump into a conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How have TV shows changed over the years?
followUp: Depending on how old the person you are talking with is, this might be a rich vein of conversation. Boy howdy has TV changed a lot over the years.
sectionContext: With so much great TV out there, it’s a great way to jump into a conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: If you could bring back one TV show that was canceled, which one would you bring back?
followUp: We all have that one show that was so good we can’t believe it got canceled *cough* Firefly *cough*. Find out what show they fell in love with.
sectionContext: With so much great TV out there, it’s a great way to jump into a conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you think about game shows? Do you have a favorite one?
followUp: While they have fallen a bit out of favor, whoever you are talking to probably has a special love for at least one game show.
sectionContext: With so much great TV out there, it’s a great way to jump into a conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s the most underrated or overrated TV show?
followUp: Whichever way they choose to answer will probably lead to a pretty interesting conversation about the merits and failures of several TV shows.
sectionContext: With so much great TV out there, it’s a great way to jump into a conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you think about reality TV? Why do you think it’s so popular?
followUp: Love it or hate it, reality TV is huge. Now you can have a conversation about why it’s so popular. If you are looking for a simpler, more direct question, you can try the next one.
sectionContext: With so much great TV out there, it’s a great way to jump into a conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you like reality TV shows? Why or why not? If so, which ones?
followUp: Very similar to the previous one but a little narrower. I definitely wouldn’t ask both of these, but either one will probably get you a good conversation going.
sectionContext: With so much great TV out there, it’s a great way to jump into a conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the most overrated movie?
