sectionContext: Everyone loves a good movie, so why not make it a conversation topic!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s your favorite genre of movie?
followUp: Pretty typical conversations starter, but a great jumping-off point for a discussion about their favorite movies.
sectionContext: Everyone loves a good movie, so why not make it a conversation topic!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Which do you prefer? Books or movies?
followUp: Feel free to transition this one into books made from movies, movies adapted from books, or just a general conversation about books or movies.
sectionContext: Everyone loves a good movie, so why not make it a conversation topic!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What movie scene choked you up the most?
followUp: We’ve all got that scene that consistently chokes us up. Find out what movie brings a tear to their eye or which movie brings on a full sobbing fit.
sectionContext: Everyone loves a good movie, so why not make it a conversation topic!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you like documentaries? Why / why not?
followUp: Perfect for starting a great conversation about the best and worst documentaries you’ve both seen.
sectionContext: Everyone loves a good movie, so why not make it a conversation topic!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s the worst movie you have seen recently?
followUp: There is definitely no shortage of bad movies to pick from, so I’m sure they’ll be able to think of at least a couple of really bad movies. You can also transition into a conversation about what makes a movie bad and what tropes you hate in movies.
sectionContext: Everyone loves a good movie, so why not make it a conversation topic!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s the strangest movie you have ever seen?
followUp: There are some BIZARRE movies out there. I’m sure you’ve seen a few, but if you haven’t, treat yourself. There is nothing quite like a movie so strange and terrible that it’s entertaining on a whole new level.
sectionContext: Everyone loves a good movie, so why not make it a conversation topic!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you like horror movies? Why or why not?
followUp: It’s weird, but people seem to either really like horror movies, or they are just not into them. There don’t seem to be a lot of people on the fence that can take them or leave them.
sectionContext: Everyone loves a good movie, so why not make it a conversation topic!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: When was the last time you went to a movie theater?
followUp: You can use this question to start up a conversation about the movie they saw, the local theater, or movie theaters in general.
sectionContext: Everyone loves a good movie, so why not make it a conversation topic!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What was the last movie you watched? How was it?
followUp: Maybe you saw it too, or maybe you’ll get a good recommendation for a movie you wouldn’t normally consider.
sectionContext: Everyone loves a good movie, so why not make it a conversation topic!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do movies have the same power as books to change the world?
followUp: This one is kind of a heavy one, so you might not want to drop it to start a conversation with someone you just met. Or maybe that’s your jam, you do you.
sectionContext: Everyone loves a good movie, so why not make it a conversation topic!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you prefer to watch movies in the theater or in the comfort of your own home?
followUp: Big screen and big sound vs. comfort and convenience. Either way, I think we can agree, movies are pretty awesome.
sectionContext: Everyone loves a good movie, so why not make it a conversation topic!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What was the last book you read?
followUp: A good question to see what kind of books they are into. And if they really liked the book, well now you’ve got a good recommendation.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters for the book lovers out there.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What was your favorite book as a child?
followUp: This can either be one when they were really young or when they were young adults. It’s another question to draw out some fond memories.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters for the book lovers out there.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you prefer physical books or ebooks?
followUp: They both have their good points and drawbacks, and often people have a definite preference.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters for the book lovers out there.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the longest book you’ve read?
followUp: This one isn’t a competition. But it is great for finding good books. If they finished the whole thing, it must have been good!
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters for the book lovers out there.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What book genres do you like to read?
followUp: It’s funny how even people who read a lot of books usually lean heavily in the direction of two or three genres.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters for the book lovers out there.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How fast do you read?
followUp: Again, not a competition. No bragging. Just a fun question for folks who love books.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters for the book lovers out there.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How often do you go to the library?
followUp: This question is perfect for starting a conversation about how libraries are changing and your local library. Did you know some libraries are starting to loan tools and cooking supplies as well as books? Very cool.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters for the book lovers out there.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What book has influenced you the most?
followUp: Whether they read it recently or long ago, there is probably one book that has stuck with them over the years.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters for the book lovers out there.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you prefer fiction or nonfiction books?
followUp: Don’t forget to ask why they prefer one over the other and get some recommendations for their choice.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters for the book lovers out there.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What book has changed one of your long-held opinions?
followUp: Books have the power to shape and change how we view the world. Usually for the better.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters for the book lovers out there.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What book has had the biggest effect on the modern world?
followUp: This is another one of those questions that can get quite deep and philosophical quite quickly. So, make sure to take stock of the situation before busting this one out.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters for the book lovers out there.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What was the worst book you had to read for school? How about the best book you had to read for school?
followUp: We all had to read lots of books for school, and you both probably read some of the same books. You might have come away with very similar or very different opinions of the books, either way it can lead to a good conversation.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters for the book lovers out there.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you think people read more or fewer books now than 50 years ago?
followUp: Sure, the knee jerk reaction is to say definitely people read more in the past. But with the spread of so many screens, I’m not so sure.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters for the book lovers out there.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Now that indie publishing has become easier, have books gotten better or worse?
followUp: Or perhaps stayed the same, one thing is for sure, there are a ton more books out there.
sectionContext: Here are some conversation starters for the book lovers out there.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What was the last song you listened to?
followUp: Have they been playing a new favorite on repeat, reminiscing, or just trying something new?
sectionContext: Time to pump the jam! And by pump the jam, I mean ask conversation questions about music.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is your favorite movie soundtrack?
followUp: Definitely some great soundtracks out there and of course, some really horrible ones as well. Feel free to transition into a conversation about movies or game soundtracks or whatever.
sectionContext: Time to pump the jam! And by pump the jam, I mean ask conversation questions about music.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you like classical music?
followUp: This is another space where some people are really into it, and some people hate it.
sectionContext: Time to pump the jam! And by pump the jam, I mean ask conversation questions about music.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What song always puts you in a good mood?
followUp: Which song is their feel-good go to? Feel free to steal it. Everyone needs more feel-good music in their life.
sectionContext: Time to pump the jam! And by pump the jam, I mean ask conversation questions about music.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s the best way to discover new music?
followUp: There is a ton to talk about here with all the new music platforms; it’s never been easier to get music, whether it’s easier to find good new music is debatable.
sectionContext: Time to pump the jam! And by pump the jam, I mean ask conversation questions about music.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How has technology changed the music industry?
followUp: This is a really broad topic with a lot of avenues to follow and can really lead to some excellent conversations.
sectionContext: Time to pump the jam! And by pump the jam, I mean ask conversation questions about music.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Are there any songs that always bring a tear to your eye?
followUp: Whether it triggers a bittersweet memory or is just a sad song, most folks have a song that chokes them up a bit.
sectionContext: Time to pump the jam! And by pump the jam, I mean ask conversation questions about music.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What bands or types of music do you listen to when you exercise?
followUp: I can almost guarantee if they are into exercise, they have a particular type of music that works for them. And lots of types that definitely don’t.
sectionContext: Time to pump the jam! And by pump the jam, I mean ask conversation questions about music.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Which do you prefer, popular music or relatively unknown music?
followUp: No judgment, lots of people get uptight about what music people should or should not like. But hey it’s not your ears. Come to this question with an open mind.
sectionContext: Time to pump the jam! And by pump the jam, I mean ask conversation questions about music.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you like going to concerts? Why or why not? What was the last concert you went to?
followUp: There are people who think concerts are alright, and those who REALLY love concerts. This can easily lead to a good conversation about concerts they’ve been to.
sectionContext: Time to pump the jam! And by pump the jam, I mean ask conversation questions about music.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Who was the first band or musician you were really into? Do you still like them?
followUp: So, this will probably pull up some cheesy music memories, and that’s always fun. We all have some cheesy music in our past and present, embrace it.
sectionContext: Time to pump the jam! And by pump the jam, I mean ask conversation questions about music.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Records, tapes, CDs, MP3s, streaming. Which did you grow up with? What is good and bad about each?
followUp: Yeah, this one is going to vary greatly depending on the age of the person you are talking to. Just don’t get all elitist about your preferred method of getting music to your ears, it’s not a good look.
sectionContext: Time to pump the jam! And by pump the jam, I mean ask conversation questions about music.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What are the three best apps on your phone?
followUp: App recommendation time! Go find you some awesome new apps.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a ton on our phone, why not have a conversation about apps?
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the most useful app on your phone?
followUp: Similar to the last but a bit more specific, and although it might not be one of their favorites, it’s one that they can’t live without.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a ton on our phone, why not have a conversation about apps?
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do app makers do that really annoys you?
followUp: The ads? The microtransactions? Bait and switch tactics? There are some really annoying and shady things about apps that annoy a lot of people.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a ton on our phone, why not have a conversation about apps?
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How many apps do you have on your phone?
followUp: I’m willing to bet they have no idea, and you probably don’t either. Heck, even I don’t. Now you can count them up and compare. And probably be surprised at how many apps you have on your phone.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a ton on our phone, why not have a conversation about apps?
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s the most frustrating app you have tried?
followUp: Whether it be a malfunctioning app or a really frustrating game, there are plenty of apps that get rage deleted. And you might even learn about some that you want to avoid.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a ton on our phone, why not have a conversation about apps?
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s the most addictive game on your phone you have played?
followUp: We’ve all been there. Sure, you know you should quit, but it’s just so good! Looking for another addicting game? Try some of our conversation games like never have I ever, 21 questions game, truth or dare, or our would you rather questions.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a ton on our phone, why not have a conversation about apps?
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Which app seemed like magic the first time you used it?
followUp: With all the tech around us, we often forget how cool it really is. I’m sure there were apps you tried in the past, and you were just dumbfounded with how amazing they were.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a ton on our phone, why not have a conversation about apps?
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the strangest app you have heard of or tried?
followUp: Oh, there are some weird ones out there. Now you can swap stories of bizarre apps. And if you don’t know of any, just Google them and be amazed.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a ton on our phone, why not have a conversation about apps?
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What're the best and worst things about the marketplace where you get your apps?
followUp: While probably not the most thrilling conversation starter, whoever you are talking about probably has a bit to say about where they get their apps.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a ton on our phone, why not have a conversation about apps?
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Which app has helped society the most? Which one has hurt society the most?
followUp: This one can get into a really deep conversation about technology and society. Or not. It depends on how the conversation flows. Either way I’m sure you’ll be able to get into a good conversation with this one.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a ton on our phone, why not have a conversation about apps?
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: An app mysteriously appears on your phone that does something amazing. What does it do?
followUp: Everyone loves a good hypothetical. So, what does your mysterious/magical app do?
sectionContext: We’ve all got a ton on our phone, why not have a conversation about apps?
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How often do you check your phone?
followUp: Answers will vary, wildly. Some people hate checking their phone, some do it compulsively.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a phone, so we’ve all got something in common to talk about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you text more or call more? Why?
followUp: While there are outliers, the answer to this one will depend a LOT on age. And probably they have strong opinions about their preference, which always makes for a good conversation. As long as you don’t start arguing with them.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a phone, so we’ve all got something in common to talk about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What will phones be like in 10 years?
followUp: Pure speculation, but why not? Speculation is fun, and who knows, you or the person you are talking to might be right with your guesses.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a phone, so we’ve all got something in common to talk about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you wish your phone could do?
followUp: They are getting better and better, but are they getting better in the way you want them to? What features would you like to see in the next round of phones?
sectionContext: We’ve all got a phone, so we’ve all got something in common to talk about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you always have to have the latest phone?
followUp: There are basically three camps. The early adopter camp, the “it ain’t broke, don’t fix it” camp, and the “I hate new technology” camp. Find out which one they are in.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a phone, so we’ve all got something in common to talk about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the most annoying thing about your phone?
followUp: Phones, it’s often a love-hate relationship. Now you can both complain about your phones. Together!
sectionContext: We’ve all got a phone, so we’ve all got something in common to talk about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How do you feel if you accidentally leave your phone at home?
followUp: For some people, they get REALLY anxious without their phone, and for some it’s just a minor inconvenience.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a phone, so we’ve all got something in common to talk about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What kind of case do you have for your phone? Why did you choose it?
followUp: This is another one that people sometimes get really passionate about, and some don’t. It might lead to a good conversation, or they might just say, “I don’t know, I just liked how it looked.”
sectionContext: We’ve all got a phone, so we’ve all got something in common to talk about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What was your first smartphone? How did you feel when you got it?
followUp: Whether young or old. You’ll always remember your first.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a phone, so we’ve all got something in common to talk about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you experience phantom vibration? (Feeling your phone vibrate even though it didn’t.)
followUp: This one goes along with the compulsive checking of phones. But I think it’s a pretty common phenomenon.
sectionContext: We’ve all got a phone, so we’ve all got something in common to talk about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What sports do you like to watch?
followUp: Try to find one that you both have in common, or you both follow. Once you find it, the rest of the conversation will flow naturally.
sectionContext: Sports! There’s a reason it’s one of the most popular conversation topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Who are some of your favorite athletes?
followUp: If you are into sports, you have favorite athletes. Find out who their favorite athletes are and why they like them.
sectionContext: Sports! There’s a reason it’s one of the most popular conversation topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Which sports do you like to play
followUp: This may be very similar to which sports they like to watch, or it could be a completely different list. Either way, talking about something the person is passionate about is always a great way to have a good conversation.
sectionContext: Sports! There’s a reason it’s one of the most popular conversation topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the hardest sport to excel at?
followUp: This one is pretty debatable. The case could be made for plenty of sports. Give this question a go and see if you both agree.
sectionContext: Sports! There’s a reason it’s one of the most popular conversation topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Who are the 3 greatest athletes of all time?
followUp: Another one that you can debate a lot about. Probably easiest to pick a sport to narrow it down first, though.
sectionContext: Sports! There’s a reason it’s one of the most popular conversation topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How much time do you spend watching sports in a week?
followUp: This one probably depends a lot on their favorite sport, and the season it’s played in. Or they might just be super into sports. Or they might not like sports. But if they don’t like sports, then why are you talking to them about sports?
sectionContext: Sports! There’s a reason it’s one of the most popular conversation topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do athletes deserve the high salaries they receive? Why or why not?
followUp: This one can be a little contentious at times. But it should lead to a lively conversation no matter what side of the coin they fall on.
sectionContext: Sports! There’s a reason it’s one of the most popular conversation topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What defines a sport? Is fishing a sport? How about video game tournaments?
followUp: This one can lead to an excellent conversation because everyone has an opinion, and all the opinions are on a sliding scale. There is definitely a limit on what someone will consider a sport.
sectionContext: Sports! There’s a reason it’s one of the most popular conversation topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you play in any fantasy sports leagues? If so, how into fantasy sports are you?
followUp: There a lot of people who are REALLY into fantasy sports. If the person you are talking to is into it, they are more than happy to have a conversation about their team.
sectionContext: Sports! There’s a reason it’s one of the most popular conversation topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Why do you think sports are common across almost all cultures present and past?
followUp: This is a little deeper than the normal sports question. But it can lead to an interesting conversation about human nature with a bit of a sports spin.
sectionContext: Sports! There’s a reason it’s one of the most popular conversation topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you play sports video games? Which ones? Is playing the video game or playing the sport more fun? Why?
followUp: If they like sports, there is a good chance they play some kind of video game involving sports. Even if it is just an app on their phone.
sectionContext: Sports! There’s a reason it’s one of the most popular conversation topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Which sport is the most exciting to watch? Which is the most boring to watch?
followUp: Oh yeah, everyone has an opinion about this one.
sectionContext: Sports! There’s a reason it’s one of the most popular conversation topics.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What restaurant do you eat at most?
followUp: Which one is their go-to restaurant? This will probably tell you a lot about what types of restaurants they like.
sectionContext: Nearly everyone enjoys going out to eat at a restaurant. So, here are some questions to help you have a conversation about restaurants!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s the worst fast food restaurant?
followUp: A lot of fast food is pretty terrible, so which is the worst?
sectionContext: Nearly everyone enjoys going out to eat at a restaurant. So, here are some questions to help you have a conversation about restaurants!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the best restaurant in your area?
followUp: It may be their local go-to restaurant, or it might be one that they only eat at for special occasions.
sectionContext: Nearly everyone enjoys going out to eat at a restaurant. So, here are some questions to help you have a conversation about restaurants!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the fanciest restaurant you have eaten at?
followUp: The sky is the limit, and so this one will probably lead to a good story. You can also branch off into a conversation about ridiculously expensive foods or things in general.
sectionContext: Nearly everyone enjoys going out to eat at a restaurant. So, here are some questions to help you have a conversation about restaurants!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What kind of interior do you like a restaurant to have?
followUp: Bright and modern, dim and cozy, more like a bar, lots of kitsch? Restaurant décor comes in almost as many flavors as food. So, what do you and they like the most? Or the least?
sectionContext: Nearly everyone enjoys going out to eat at a restaurant. So, here are some questions to help you have a conversation about restaurants!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the worst restaurant you have ever eaten at?
followUp: We’ve all got one, and they are always entertaining to hear about.
sectionContext: Nearly everyone enjoys going out to eat at a restaurant. So, here are some questions to help you have a conversation about restaurants!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: If you opened a restaurant, what kind of food would you serve?
followUp: This is another one that a lot of people have thought about. For some reason opening a restaurant appeals to a lot of people and so you’ll probably get an interesting answer for this one.
sectionContext: Nearly everyone enjoys going out to eat at a restaurant. So, here are some questions to help you have a conversation about restaurants!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the strangest themed restaurant you have heard of?
followUp: If you haven’t heard of strangely themed restaurants, boy howdy are you in for a roller coaster. Just Google it, people go buck wild with restaurant themes.
sectionContext: Nearly everyone enjoys going out to eat at a restaurant. So, here are some questions to help you have a conversation about restaurants!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Would you eat at a restaurant that was really dirty if the food was amazing?
followUp: How close to the food poisoning sun do you want to fly, Icarus?
sectionContext: Nearly everyone enjoys going out to eat at a restaurant. So, here are some questions to help you have a conversation about restaurants!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the most disgusting thing you have heard happened at a restaurant?
followUp: This one piggybacks on to the last question. We’ve all heard horror stories. Now it’s your turn share yours and to hear theirs.
sectionContext: Nearly everyone enjoys going out to eat at a restaurant. So, here are some questions to help you have a conversation about restaurants!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What was your favorite restaurant when you were a child?
followUp: I find that a lot of people have really strong favorites when it comes to this period in their life.
sectionContext: Nearly everyone enjoys going out to eat at a restaurant. So, here are some questions to help you have a conversation about restaurants!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Where would you like to travel next?
followUp: Most people have a spot they have their eyes and heart on. Find out where it is, maybe you’ve been and can give them some tips.
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the longest plane trip you have taken?
followUp: Who doesn’t love long plane trips? Everyone! Everyone hates long plane rides. So, find out about their horror stories and share your own.
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What's the best way to travel? (Plane, car, train, etc.)
followUp: This one probably varies a lot, depending on what country you are in. But usually people have a favorite they like to talk about.
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Where is the most relaxing place you have been?
followUp: Are they more of a beach and chill or a cabin and chill kind of person? Find out with this question.
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you prefer traveling alone or with a group?
followUp: They both have their benefits and drawbacks. And almost everyone has a preference. Plus, it’s a great starting point to talk about previous trips they’ve taken.
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you think of tour group packages?
followUp: This one is somewhat similar to the last one but a little more specific. If you’ve already covered a lot of tour group ground with the last question, feel free to skip this one.
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you prefer to go off the beaten path when you travel?
followUp: Whether it’s literally going off the beaten path like when they are hiking, or just the figurative beaten path like a guidebook, you can use this question to find out how adventurous they like to be.
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What was the most overhyped place you've traveled to?
followUp: If you’ve traveled to any popular destinations, you may have come across this. So much hype. But a big letdown once you get there.
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Have you traveled to any different countries? Which ones?
followUp: Depending on what country you are both from the answers to this question vary a lot. Are you in the US? You might find most people haven’t left the country or have just been to one or two other countries. Asking in Europe? You’ll probably get a ton of travel stories about different countries.
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Where is the most awe-inspiring place you have been?
followUp: This is great for getting new travel ideas for yourself. And if you’ve been there, you can talk about your experience too.
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What's the best thing about traveling? How about the worst thing?
followUp: Again, this will vary a lot based on who you are talking to and how they travel. But chances are they have pretty strong feelings about both questions.
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the worst hotel you have stayed at? How about the best hotel?
followUp: So many bad hotels out there. Get ready for some horror stories about gross stuff. Or you know, a tip about a sweet hotel you can try. It depends on how the conversation goes.
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How do you think traveling to a lot of different countries changes a person?
followUp: Someone once said you are the same person you were 5 years ago except for the places you’ve been, the people you’ve met, and the books you’ve read. So, what do you think travel does to someone?
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Talk about some of the interesting people you have met while traveling.
followUp: Oh, this one leads to rich veins of great stories. I’m sure you have a lot of stories about interesting characters you’ve met, and they probably do too.
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you think of staycations? (Vacationing and seeing tourist attractions where you live.)
followUp: Some people love them, and some don’t see the point. Either way, there is plenty to talk about!
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Where do you get your recommendations for what to do and where to stay when you travel?
followUp: Is it from fellow travelers, guidebooks, the internet, social media, or a combination?
sectionContext: Whether it is near or far, everyone loves a good vacation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is your favorite piece of technology that you own?
followUp: Let’s start it out positive and see what kind of tech they rely on.
sectionContext: Tech, some hate it, and some love it, but even those who love it probably have a love/hate thing going on with it. Either way, it makes for some great conversation questions!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What piece of technology is really frustrating to use?
followUp: And now, let’s look at the dark side of tech when it just doesn’t work the way we want it to. Probably a lot more to talk about in this question than the previous one.
sectionContext: Tech, some hate it, and some love it, but even those who love it probably have a love/hate thing going on with it. Either way, it makes for some great conversation questions!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What was the best invention of the last 50 years?
followUp: Lots of good answers to this one. You both will probably come up with quite a few contenders. And it can be fun to debate the merits of each.
sectionContext: Tech, some hate it, and some love it, but even those who love it probably have a love/hate thing going on with it. Either way, it makes for some great conversation questions!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Does technology simplify life or make it more complicated?
followUp: This one sometimes leads to an interesting conversation about tech and modern life, but if the person lands hard on one side or the other usually there isn’t much more to talk about.
sectionContext: Tech, some hate it, and some love it, but even those who love it probably have a love/hate thing going on with it. Either way, it makes for some great conversation questions!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Will technology save the human race or destroy it?
followUp: So, this is a pretty heavy question that you don’t want to drop in casual conversation. It’s better left for conversations with people you know quite well, or folks who you know are into this type of question.
sectionContext: Tech, some hate it, and some love it, but even those who love it probably have a love/hate thing going on with it. Either way, it makes for some great conversation questions!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Which emerging technology are you most excited about?
followUp: There is a lot of promising tech fields that seem like they are just on the horizon. So which ones are you looking forward to? And perhaps which make you a little uneasy?
sectionContext: Tech, some hate it, and some love it, but even those who love it probably have a love/hate thing going on with it. Either way, it makes for some great conversation questions!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What sci-fi movie or book would you like the future to be like?
followUp: So many futures to choose from. Especially if you or the person you are talking to is a sci-fi fan. Everything from dystopian utopias to utopian dystopias.
sectionContext: Tech, some hate it, and some love it, but even those who love it probably have a love/hate thing going on with it. Either way, it makes for some great conversation questions!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you think the next big technological advance will be?
followUp: This is similar to the emerging technologies question, but this one isn’t about playing favorites, but about which will arrive first.
sectionContext: Tech, some hate it, and some love it, but even those who love it probably have a love/hate thing going on with it. Either way, it makes for some great conversation questions!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What technology from a science fiction movie would you most like to have?
followUp: Even if you don’t like sci-fi movies, you’ve probably craved a gadget that featured in a movie or book. This can lead to a fun spin-off conversation about gadgets.
sectionContext: Tech, some hate it, and some love it, but even those who love it probably have a love/hate thing going on with it. Either way, it makes for some great conversation questions!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What problems will technology solve in the next 5 years? What problems will it create?
followUp: Everybody likes making predictions about the future, it’s one of the human race’s defining features. And another common human behavior is fear about the future. Probably why many people are always making dire predictions that never come to pass.
sectionContext: Tech, some hate it, and some love it, but even those who love it probably have a love/hate thing going on with it. Either way, it makes for some great conversation questions!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What piece of technology would look like magic or a miracle to people in medieval Europe?
followUp: What awesome revolutionary invention would get you executed with a quickness back in the day?
sectionContext: Tech, some hate it, and some love it, but even those who love it probably have a love/hate thing going on with it. Either way, it makes for some great conversation questions!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Can you think of any technology that has only made the world worse? How about a piece of technology that has only made the world better?
followUp: Probably you both can think of quite a few from each category. And probably plenty of tech that has made the world better and worse at the same time.
sectionContext: Tech, some hate it, and some love it, but even those who love it probably have a love/hate thing going on with it. Either way, it makes for some great conversation questions!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is your favorite shirt?
followUp: Whether it’s for comfort, style, or just an exceptionally clever or funny t-shirt, everyone has a favorite.
sectionContext: Conversation questions about clothes are always in fashion.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Does fashion help society in any way?
followUp: This is a bit philosophical but can be a fun one to discuss. If the person seems into deeper conversations, you could give this one a go.
sectionContext: Conversation questions about clothes are always in fashion.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What old trend is coming back these days?
followUp: It seems that fashion always pulls from the past. Whether it’s coloring, types of clothes, or just the general style of a past decade. So, which past fashion trends are they pulling from currently?
sectionContext: Conversation questions about clothes are always in fashion.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is a fashion trend you are really glad went away?
followUp: This can be the start of a fun conversation about the ridiculous fashions that have come and gone in recent decades.
sectionContext: Conversation questions about clothes are always in fashion.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the most comfortable piece of clothing you own?
followUp: It might be their favorite t-shirt, or perhaps some comfy pajamas. Either way there is bound to be something that they love relaxing in.
sectionContext: Conversation questions about clothes are always in fashion.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the most embarrassing piece of clothing you own?
followUp: This is always a fun one, we all have some embarrassing pieces of clothing lurking in our closet that we either secretly love or just haven’t gotten around to tossing out.
sectionContext: Conversation questions about clothes are always in fashion.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How do clothes change how the opposite sex views a person?
followUp: Another one that can lead to some deeper conversations about society or might just stay superficial. Just make sure you are in the right social situation to ask this one.
sectionContext: Conversation questions about clothes are always in fashion.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you care about fashion? What style of clothes do you usually wear?
followUp: Some people care a lot about fashion, some don’t, and some care a lot but pretend that they don’t. Which one are they?
sectionContext: Conversation questions about clothes are always in fashion.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: If you didn’t care at all what people thought of you, what clothes would you wear?
followUp: It might be what they are currently wearing, or it might be something totally different. It all depends on how well their ideal clothing matches current trends. It’s always fun, though, if the person is into cosplay or period clothing.
sectionContext: Conversation questions about clothes are always in fashion.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the best pair of shoes you have ever owned? Why were they so good?
followUp: Comfortable shoes that look good are a rare find. You might just get some good tips on a new pair of kicks.
sectionContext: Conversation questions about clothes are always in fashion.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Who do you think has the biggest impact on fashion trends: actors and actresses, musicians, fashion designers, or consumers?
followUp: This sounds like a question from a fashion textbook, but it can actually often lead to some thoughtful answers and a good conversation.
sectionContext: Conversation questions about clothes are always in fashion.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What personal goals do you have?
followUp: Some people are a little cagey about their personal goals, and some are pretty open to sharing them. Just don’t make this one the first question you ask a person. Best to get to know them a bit better before popping this one.
sectionContext: Let’s talk about goooooooooaaaaaaaaals!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What are your goals for the next two years?
followUp: Similar to the last one, but this one is a little more specific and deals with midterm goals rather than long term goals.
sectionContext: Let’s talk about goooooooooaaaaaaaaals!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How have your goals changed over your life?
followUp: Oh, I guarantee your and their goals have changed quite a bit from 10 or 20 years ago. It’s always fun to talk about goals from the past.
sectionContext: Let’s talk about goooooooooaaaaaaaaals!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How much do you plan for the future?
followUp: The answers to this one vary a lot from person to person. And it’s a great one to find out if they are spur of the moment or more methodical.
sectionContext: Let’s talk about goooooooooaaaaaaaaals!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How do you plan to make the world a better place?
followUp: Some people have a solid plan, some don’t care, and some, it seems, are actively trying to make the world a worse place. Find out where on the spectrum the person you are talking lands.
sectionContext: Let’s talk about goooooooooaaaaaaaaals!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What are some goals you have already achieved?
followUp: This one is pleasant because they get to talk about their successes. And even if they are humble, they probably still enjoy having their successes recognized.
sectionContext: Let’s talk about goooooooooaaaaaaaaals!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you hope to achieve in your professional life?
followUp: Switching over from personal goals, now it’s time for a conversation about professional goals.
sectionContext: Let’s talk about goooooooooaaaaaaaaals!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Have your parents influenced what goals you have?
followUp: For some, it might be a positive influence; for others the pressures might have pushed them in the opposite direction. Either way, this is a pretty personal question so make sure you know the person pretty well before asking them this question.
sectionContext: Let’s talk about goooooooooaaaaaaaaals!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you usually achieve the goals you set? Why or why not?
followUp: Again, kind of personal, and can often lead to some bummer conversations, so be wary of this one. Make sure you know the person before asking this one.
sectionContext: Let’s talk about goooooooooaaaaaaaaals!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the best way to stay motivated and complete goals?
followUp: Moving on from personal questions and kind of bummer questions, this one is looking more on the bright side of life. And you might get some good suggestions to help you achieve your own goals.
sectionContext: Let’s talk about goooooooooaaaaaaaaals!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What are some goals you have failed to accomplish?
followUp: Whoops back into negative territory, while it can lead to a good conversation, just be cognizant of how the conversation might turn with this question.
sectionContext: Let’s talk about goooooooooaaaaaaaaals!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the craziest, most outrageous thing you want to achieve?
followUp: This one is always a fun one to ask. Sometimes the person has to think a while, and sometimes they already have it lined up. But however long it takes them to answer, the answer is usually a really good one.
sectionContext: Let’s talk about goooooooooaaaaaaaaals!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: When do you want to retire? What do you want to do when you retire?
followUp: I like this question because it gets to the point of what they really want to be doing. Not what they have to be doing. You can find out a lot about a person by learning what they want to do when they aren’t obligated to be doing anything in particular.
sectionContext: Let’s talk about goooooooooaaaaaaaaals!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you prefer summer or winter activities?
followUp: Fun in the sun or ummm.. furlough in the snow? There is probably a better rhyme than that, but for now, furlough will have to do. So, which is their jam, snow skiing or water skiing?
sectionContext: There is a time for everything. A time to sow and a time to reap. And a time to discuss seasons!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you like to do in the spring?
followUp: Whether it’s hiking or just sitting on the porch, the dawn of spring is always a pleasant time of year.
sectionContext: There is a time for everything. A time to sow and a time to reap. And a time to discuss seasons!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Did your family take seasonal vacations?
followUp: Don’t forget to follow up by asking where they would go if they answer yes to this one. Not everyone was lucky enough to be able to take vacations when they were younger, but if they were it’s always fun to hear about them.
sectionContext: There is a time for everything. A time to sow and a time to reap. And a time to discuss seasons!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Which do you prefer, fall or spring?
followUp: Both are pretty amazing, and both have some really good things going for them. But probably you and the person you are talking with have a strong preference one way or the other.
sectionContext: There is a time for everything. A time to sow and a time to reap. And a time to discuss seasons!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Which season are you most active in?
followUp: Because the seasons are so different depending on where you live, the answers to this one vary a lot from region to region. See if you and the person you are talking to agree.
sectionContext: There is a time for everything. A time to sow and a time to reap. And a time to discuss seasons!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s the most refreshing thing on a hot summer day?
followUp: Whether it’s a dip in the pool, a glass of fresh lemonade, an ice-cold beer, or something else entirely, it’s always fun to talk about the things that make us go “Ahhhhh.”
sectionContext: There is a time for everything. A time to sow and a time to reap. And a time to discuss seasons!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What’s the best thing to do on a cold winter day?
followUp: Indoors or out? Fun or warming? Lots of different ways you could go with this conversation starter.
sectionContext: There is a time for everything. A time to sow and a time to reap. And a time to discuss seasons!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Where is the nicest place you have been to in fall?
followUp: The leaves changing, the crisp air, there is something so invigorating about fall. I’m sure you have a favorite place, even if it is just a bench in a nice park.
sectionContext: There is a time for everything. A time to sow and a time to reap. And a time to discuss seasons!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is your favorite thing to eat or drink in winter?
followUp: So much warm and delicious things to eat and drink in winter, it’s pretty hard to decide. Don’t feel like you have to choose just one!
sectionContext: There is a time for everything. A time to sow and a time to reap. And a time to discuss seasons!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Is it better to live where there are four seasons or where one season takes up most of the year?
followUp: I imagine this one depends on where you live. Lots of people want what they don’t have. So, my guess is that if where you live has four seasons you probably want to live somewhere with a long summer. But feel free to test out my hypothesis with this question!
sectionContext: There is a time for everything. A time to sow and a time to reap. And a time to discuss seasons!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is the biggest holiday for your family?
followUp: Whether holidays usually end up being a big disaster or not, there is probably at least one holiday where their family goes all out.
sectionContext: Time to celebrate with some holiday conversations!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is your favorite holiday?
followUp: Whether it’s a traditional one or a newer one, everyone has a favorite. Don’t forget to ask them why it’s their favorite, as well.
sectionContext: Time to celebrate with some holiday conversations!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What holidays have been over-commercialized?
followUp: “All of them” is a totally viable answer, but this is a good steppingstone into talking about the topic in general as well as some of the newer holidays that seem to be popping up.
sectionContext: Time to celebrate with some holiday conversations!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you wish there were more or fewer holidays? Why?
followUp: So, there are a TON of “holidays” out there. But there could always be more, or different ones, or less. Or even better yet more holidays where you can take off from work or school. Those are always fun.
sectionContext: Time to celebrate with some holiday conversations!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you know about the history of some holidays?
followUp: The traditional holidays have some buck wild history to them. We’ve got some trivia pages on the site that go into some of the history behind a few popular holidays. You can find the links to those pages below.
sectionContext: Time to celebrate with some holiday conversations!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What kinds of food do you usually eat on your favorite holiday?
followUp: It wouldn’t be a holiday without food! And every holiday tends to have its own flavors. So, find out what is traditional for them and their family and see how it compares to your traditions.
sectionContext: Time to celebrate with some holiday conversations!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: If you had to get rid of a holiday, which would you get rid of? Why?
followUp: There are definitely some holidays that could use a bit of pruning, rebranding, or just be outright replaced. Looking at you, Columbus Day. With this question you can find out which holidays they aren’t a fan of.
sectionContext: Time to celebrate with some holiday conversations!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Does having a day off for a holiday increase or decrease productivity at work?
followUp: Sure, you might think that with a day off, productivity might decrease, but happy employees do tend to get more done. So, does it even out? Now you both can weigh in and decide together.
sectionContext: Time to celebrate with some holiday conversations!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: If some of the lesser-known holidays were commercialized, what would the commercialization look like?
followUp: If you can’t think of some of the lesser-known holidays, you can check out this page. So many unofficial and official holidays. So many.
sectionContext: Time to celebrate with some holiday conversations!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: If you could make a holiday, what would it be like? What traditions would it have? What would people eat on your holiday?
followUp: This one is really fun, especially if the person you are talking to is in any way creative. There are basically endless amounts of crazy holidays you could come up with.
sectionContext: Time to celebrate with some holiday conversations!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you think of online education?
followUp: Whether it be online courses for schools, Khan Academy, or tutorials on YouTube there is lots of education happening online. If the person you are talking to is into education this is a rich vein for conversations.
sectionContext: Sharpen your pencils. It’s time for an education conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you think of standardized tests?
followUp: Love them or hate them, they are an entrenched part of the school system. You could talk about possible improvements, how effective or ineffective they are, and if there are any viable alternatives.
sectionContext: Sharpen your pencils. It’s time for an education conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Are bigger or smaller schools better?
followUp: Most people will agree that small class sizes are better. But how about the whole school? What are the pros and cons of a small or a big school?
sectionContext: Sharpen your pencils. It’s time for an education conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Is teaching a skill that can be taught?
followUp: Are good teachers born, or are they created? Are there any inherent traits that might make a person more likely to be a good teacher? This one is a good pool of possible conversations to dive into.
sectionContext: Sharpen your pencils. It’s time for an education conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What will the future of education be?
followUp: Who doesn’t love some fortune-telling? See if your idea of the future of education matches up with their prediction. What would be the best outcome? What is the most likely outcome?
sectionContext: Sharpen your pencils. It’s time for an education conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you think of homeschooling?
followUp: Homeschooling is becoming more and more popular. And with anything, it has pros and cons. Whether you are for or against, it’s a great topic for those who are interested in education.
sectionContext: Sharpen your pencils. It’s time for an education conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How can governments make education more efficient?
followUp: Because if there is one thing I’ve learned, it’s that people are totally happy with the public-school system and there is no room for improvement.
sectionContext: Sharpen your pencils. It’s time for an education conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How has the education you received changed your life?
followUp: And if you don’t think it’s changed your life in any way, just imagine having no education, and you can see the impact of education.
sectionContext: Sharpen your pencils. It’s time for an education conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: How can technology improve education? Can it hurt education?
followUp: As with anything involved with technology, the use of technology in the classroom is hotly debated. Most want more, some want less. What kind of technology would you like to see put into the classroom, and is there any you would want to be taken out?
sectionContext: Sharpen your pencils. It’s time for an education conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What or who has taught you most of the information you use regularly?
followUp: Is it school, friends, family, the internet? We pull information from lots of sources. Which do you think is the best source for good information?
sectionContext: Sharpen your pencils. It’s time for an education conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What are some good and bad things about the education system in your country?
followUp: This kind of brings all the previous questions together in a big whopper of a question. Get ready for a long conversation with this question.
sectionContext: Sharpen your pencils. It’s time for an education conversation.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What is your favorite cuisine or type of food?
followUp: Everyone has a favorite type of food, whether it be international or local. And even if it is international cuisine, there is probably a local spin to it. This question transitions nicely into what their favorite foods are.
sectionContext: Whether they are a foodie or not, everyone has to eat, and that makes it a great topic to have a conversation about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What foods do you absolutely hate?
followUp: Everyone has foods they can’t stand. And they usually like talking about why they hate them so much!
sectionContext: Whether they are a foodie or not, everyone has to eat, and that makes it a great topic to have a conversation about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you think of buffets?
followUp: With this one, you might have to consider how the person might take it. If they are a little on the heavier side, they might think you are making a comment about their weight. Just a heads up, so you don’t offend anyone accidentally.
sectionContext: Whether they are a foodie or not, everyone has to eat, and that makes it a great topic to have a conversation about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: When was the last time you had a food fight?
followUp: Who doesn’t love a good food fight? Well, I guess anyone who doesn’t want food on their clothes… or anyone who doesn’t like wasting food… but still they can be fun.
sectionContext: Whether they are a foodie or not, everyone has to eat, and that makes it a great topic to have a conversation about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What food looks disgusting but tastes delicious?
followUp: There are so many foods out there that are like this. My guess is that you can think of a couple off the top of your head, and I bet whoever you are talking to can as well!
sectionContext: Whether they are a foodie or not, everyone has to eat, and that makes it a great topic to have a conversation about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What do you get every time you go grocery shopping?
followUp: We all have that one snack or treat that we just can’t get enough of. And who knows you might just find your next favorite snack by asking this question.
sectionContext: Whether they are a foodie or not, everyone has to eat, and that makes it a great topic to have a conversation about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: If your life was a meal, what would kind of meal would it be?
followUp: Definitely a weird one. But it can be fun depending on how creative you both get with it. The fun is in the explanation of why it would be that kind of meal.
sectionContext: Whether they are a foodie or not, everyone has to eat, and that makes it a great topic to have a conversation about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What would you want your last meal to be if you were on death row?
followUp: What’s the perfect meal to go out on?
sectionContext: Whether they are a foodie or not, everyone has to eat, and that makes it a great topic to have a conversation about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What food do you know you shouldn’t eat but can’t stop yourself?
followUp: Don’t worry, I think we all do. And probably the person you are talking to has one as well.
sectionContext: Whether they are a foodie or not, everyone has to eat, and that makes it a great topic to have a conversation about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Do you like spicy food? Why or why not? What is the spiciest thing you have ever eaten?
followUp: And have you seen some of the videos of people eating spicy food or peppers? Whew, some of those look really painful, especially when they wipe tears away, and it gets in their eyes. Ouch.
sectionContext: Whether they are a foodie or not, everyone has to eat, and that makes it a great topic to have a conversation about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: Does the government have a place in regulating food? To what extent should government regulate food?
followUp: This can definitely get political, so fair warning you may want to avoid this one if you don’t want to get into a conversation about politics and regulation.
sectionContext: Whether they are a foodie or not, everyone has to eat, and that makes it a great topic to have a conversation about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: When people make mistakes about food (especially foreign food), do you feel the need to correct them?
followUp: Some people like to know when they get something wrong, and some definitely don’t. Are you one of the people that gets annoyed when someone corrects you about food, or do you appreciate being corrected?
sectionContext: Whether they are a foodie or not, everyone has to eat, and that makes it a great topic to have a conversation about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: If your mind were an island, what would it look like?
followUp: Whoa, dude, we are all like islands unto ourselves.
sectionContext: Bring your creativity; you are going to need it.

text: What flavor of ice cream do you wish existed?
followUp: So many flavor possibilities. I want spicy ice cream. I know it’s probably out there; I just haven’t run across it yet.
sectionContext: Bring your creativity; you are going to need it.

text: If you had a personal mascot, what would your mascot be?
followUp: Animal, ethnic stereotype, or something more abstract?
sectionContext: Bring your creativity; you are going to need it.

text: If you were a king/queen, what would your throne look like?
followUp: Just remember it can be any shape, size, and be made out of any combination of things.
sectionContext: Bring your creativity; you are going to need it.

text: Time freezes for everyone but you for one day. What do you do?

sectionContext: Bring your creativity; you are going to need it.

text: You have to relive one day of your life forever. Which day do you choose?
followUp: Welcome to Groundhog Day, but now you get to pick. Also, there is no way out, infinite loop, but you can do whatever you want on each day.
sectionContext: Bring your creativity; you are going to need it.

text: What does your own personal hell look like? How about your own personal heaven?
followUp: Put your Dante hat on and get to creating!
sectionContext: Bring your creativity; you are going to need it.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: You find a remote that can rewind, fast forward, stop, and start time. What do you do with it?
followUp: Yeah, I know there was a lame movie about this. But it is still a pretty cool hypothetical.
sectionContext: Bring your creativity; you are going to need it.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: If you could call up anyone in the world and have a one-hour conversation, who would you call?
followUp: You could learn something from them by asking questions, you could try to convince them to do something or not do something, or you could just try to befriend them.
sectionContext: Bring your creativity; you are going to need it.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: The world has become infested with rabid dogs with the intelligence of a 5-year-old, where do you hole up to survive the “a-pup-calypse”?
followUp: I’m not sure if this has been made into a really cheesy horror film, but if it hasn’t, it should be.
sectionContext: Bring your creativity; you are going to need it.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: A portal to another world opens in front of you. You don’t know how long it will stay open or if you’ll be able to get back after you go through. What do you do?
followUp: You don’t know if what’s on the other side is bad or good, but you’ll need to make a choice relatively quickly.
sectionContext: Bring your creativity; you are going to need it.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 250 Conversation Starters

text: What was your best drop the mic moment?
followUp: Who doesn't like telling an awesome story about themselves? This will give your guy a chance to tell you a good story and is a great way to get him talking. It will also let you know what kinds of things he is into and what he considers important.
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy

text: What childish thing do you still enjoy?
followUp: We all have things that we carry over from our childhood and I'm sure he does too. He might not admit it but he probably still likes peeing in the snow and building sand castles. This question is likely to get you some cute answers. Remember you don't have to limit it to just one childish thing, you can get him to list off more.
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy

text: What’s the biggest doubt you have?
followUp: We all have doubts. Whether those doubts are about the world at large or ourselves. This one can really lead to a serious conversation but sharing doubts can be an excellent way of creating a strong bond between two people.
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy

text: Who has completely lost your respect?
followUp: A great question for seeing what values he thinks are important. Also a great conversation starter as there are more than few celebrities that have fallen from grace.
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy

text: What movie do you wish life was more like?
followUp: Another question that is fun to answer and gets a really unique conversation going. Just remember to talk about the small things that would change as well. Really dive into how everyday life would change if it was more like the movie he choose. Don't be afraid to take it to a ridiculous level.
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy

text: How many phones have you broken or lost?
followUp: A seemingly simple question that sometimes can lead to a really long discussion. That's because usually behind every broken or lost phone there is a story. Either that or he is just super clumsy or forgetful, which is also good to know.
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy

text: Who or what is your nemesis?
followUp: We all have things or people that we absolutely hate. I'm sure he does too. And since everyone loves talking about what annoys them, well, this is a great question to get a conversation going. If you want to, you can encourage funny or silly answers; like jars that don't open or YouTube videos that load ads perfectly but not the video. You can easily move the conversation to a lighter rant about generally annoying things.
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy

text: What is the most useless thing you know how to do?
followUp: What kind of hidden talents does he have? This is always great because usually he can show you. We all have silly and useless talents, now you can learn about his!
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy

text: What's the worst and best thing about being male?
followUp: How much do you know about what it's like being a guy? Well now is your chance to find out more. I think you'll be surprised at some of the answers the guy you are talking with will give. You might also try moving the conversation to talking about some small annoying things about being a guy. This question is really great because it's a lot of fun to answer and you'll probably find out some things you didn't know.
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy

text: What is something that most people get wrong?
followUp: Lots of different answers to this one, so it's pretty hard to guess what kind of answer he'll come up with. But it's a great little question to get a conversation going or at least come up with some complaints you can both commiserate about.
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy

text: What would you NOT do for 5 million dollars?
followUp: This is a fun one to answer. And it can tell you a lot about the guy as well. You can find out what morals he considers to be most important and what activities he finds detestable.
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy

text: What long shot have you taken that really paid off?
followUp: He's probably never been asked this question before, so be ready to give him some time to think. You'll probably get an interesting answer though, either a story or a fact that you didn't know about him.
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy

text: If you could learn only one magic spell, but it could only do something mundane and boring, what would the spell do?
followUp: A fun question that can lead to some really creative answers. Some examples might be: unclog a drain, make toast slightly more brown, unjam a copier, etc. You could further the conversation by trying to think of the incantation that would go with the spell.
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy

text: You wake up suddenly in the middle of the night. What would be the scariest sound to hear after waking up?
followUp: It's great because it might give you some insight into what he is afraid of. Either that, or you'll give him a chance to make you laugh if he want's to make it into a joke. Either way, it's a fun question to ask a guy and one that makes follow up questions easy. You can talk about amping up scariness of the situation, talk about his other fears, or perhaps try to find fears you have in common.
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy

text: What high level job do you think you could lie your way into with no experience and no one would notice?
followUp: This question has a lot of possible answers, but to really make it fun, talk about how he would be able to stop people finding out he was fraud. Sure it sounds like the plot for a bad comedy movie, but still, it's a fun question to answer.
sectionContext: Without further delay, here are 200 questions to ask a guy!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask a guy
