For the last question, I had to make it a big one. Find out what he thinks is his most shining glorious achievement.

If you are looking for another big list of conversation questions, try our 500 good questions to ask.

text: What habits do you have that annoy other people?
followUp: Yeah, annoying habits. You'll want to know these about him. Because if you two ever move in together, those annoying habits will go from cute to frustrating real quick. We all have annoying habits, so feel free to share some of yours and give him a heads up.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What makes you angrier than it should?
followUp: This is a really important question. Because you'll want to know what makes them angry so you can avoid it. And if you can't avoid making them angry, you might want to find a new boyfriend. This goes for you too, if you find yourself getting angry at them a lot, chances are that you might want to reconsider your relationship. Too much anger is toxic in relationships.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What movie was so sad that you will never watch it again?
followUp:
This is a great question for finding out a little more about their emotional side. You can see what really chokes them up. Or you can see if they really aren't that emotional.

Good to know either way, because if they never get choked up during a movie, don't expect them to be open about their own emotions in the future.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What gross and unhygienic things do people do that bothers you?
followUp:
So, how clean and hygienic is your boyfriend? If you are going to take your relationship to the next level eventually, it's good to find out sooner rather than later.

Basically if he has a long list of gross things that probably means he's pretty clean. If he just shrugs and says "I dunno", it probably means he's pretty dirty.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What habit do you have that you think not many other people have?
followUp: We all have weird habits, time to find out some of his! Just remember to try not to be too judgmental. You've probably got your share of weird habits as well.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What do most people overestimate or underestimate about you?
followUp:
This question is less about how other people view your boyfriend and more about how they view themselves. You can find out how your boyfriend thinks the world views him and how that contrasts with how he views himself.

If he sounds a little delusional, that's a bad sign. If he sounds humble, it's probably a good sign.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What is something you probably should do, but will never do?
followUp: This is a bit of a weird question that can get you a variety of answers. Great for an interesting conversation starter because he has probably never been asked this. But whatever his answer is, it'll probably be pretty interesting and enlightening.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What was the best thing about how your parents raised you?
followUp:
Ah family, sometimes a touchy topic but you can learn a lot about someone by finding out about their childhood.

Just remember to let him do the talking, don't make assumptions, and never be negative about family. People get defensive real quick if you talk bad about their family.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What do you most look forward to about getting old?
followUp: This question is a fun one to ask your boyfriend because you'll either get funny answer or a serious answer about how he wants to live after he retires. Either way it's a great question to ask.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What is the biggest sign of weakness in a person?
followUp:
This is a really interesting question to ask. Their answer will tell you a lot about how they see the world around them.

Basically whatever the sign of weakness is, that will be what he judges people most harshly for. And the opposite of that sign of weakness will be something he really admires and strives to be.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What's something you tried really hard to like but just couldn’t?
followUp: By seeing who pressured him into trying to like the thing, you can see who he tries to please. And you can also see how much he is willing to stand up to that person or group. Plus, you'll learn more about what he likes and doesn't like.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What makes you different from most people?
followUp: A great question to ask your boyfriend that will show you how much they feel like they fit into society. If they mention a lot of things, they probably see themselves as an outcast. If they don't have much to say, they probably think they fit pretty well into society. There's nothing wrong with either one, but it's good to know.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What was the best mistake you’ve made? A mistake that turned out really well.
followUp: This one probably won't tell you much about your boyfriend but it's a fun question to ask. You'll probably get to hear an interesting story. And who doesn't love a good story?
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: If you dropped everything and went on a road trip, where would you go?
followUp:
This one is similar to the "where would you live" question above. But instead of finding out where your boyfriend wants to settle down, you can find out what type of vacation your boyfriend likes.

If you both like the same stuff, that's always better. It means more things to do together and more things to talk about.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What are the manliest and least manly things you have ever done?
followUp: This is a fun question that can lead to some great answers. You can also find out how seriously they take the concept of manliness and what that concept means to them.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: How do you feel about pets and animals?
followUp: This one is good to ask for the simple reason that if one of you hates animals and one of you loves them, that means that one of you is probably going to be upset if you two move in together. It's some good general info to gather and can lead to a good conversation.

So this one is a good question because every guy will have an answer. So it's a perfect conversation starter. And you'll get to learn more about what he likes to do.

If you can get into stuff that he likes (and vice versa), you'll find that you will both have a lot more fun around each other.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What did you learn a little too late?
followUp: This is a roundabout question to find out what some of his regrets are. What does he wish he had done or learned? It'll give you an idea of where he wants to head in the future.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What are you too hard on yourself for?
followUp:
This one will let you know to what standards does he hold himself. Because if he holds himself to a standard, chances are he expects other people to meet that standard as well.

Also, if he is hard on himself about a lot of things, it probably means he is more driven to succeed. If he isn't hard on himself about anything, it probably means he is super laid back or he doesn't really want to improve himself.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: How often do you feel utterly worn down?
followUp: This question is a good indicator of how stressed he is. You can ask what wears him down and find out what he stresses about most.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: If money was no object, where would you live?
followUp: A great question for finding out how much you two match up. If you both want to live in similar places, that's definitely a good sign. But if he wants to live out in the country in a cold place and you want to live in a city in a warm place, well that doesn't bode well. It's something good to know if you plan on being together long term.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: Who was the most toxic person you’ve known?
followUp:
We've all known people that make the world around them a worse place. You can see what your boyfriend considers to be the worst of the worst in people.

Maybe you both despise the same aspect in a person or maybe not. Either way, you'll learn what types of behavior he despises.
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · Questions to ask your boyfriend
sectionTitle: Best questions to ask your boyfriend

text: What were the last two books that you read?
followUp:
Is your boyfriend a reader? Find out with this question. If you're a voracious reader and he isn't (or vice versa), that could be a problem. But if you both read about the same amount it's probably nothing to worry about.

And who knows you might learn about a cool new book that you can check out.

text: What is the TLDR version of your life?
followUp: This question will help you understand what they think is important. If their answer gets included in the highlight reel of their life so far, it must be pretty important to how they see themselves and their place in the world.
sectionContext: Here is our list of questions for the 21 Questions game. I hope you enjoy them!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 21 Questions Game

text: What should they teach in school, but don’t?
followUp: They might answer a couple of different ways on this one. Is it a subject they feel is often neglected? Is it a set of controversial beliefs or facts that they feel get left out? Perhaps it's the more practical skills that get over looked? You'll learn a little more about how they view the world after this question.
sectionContext: Here is our list of questions for the 21 Questions game. I hope you enjoy them!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 21 Questions Game

text: What inscription do you want on your gravestone?
followUp: While some of the other questions focus on what has happened in the past, this question let's you know how they want their future to play out. When they look back on their life, what do they want to have accomplished.
sectionContext: Here is our list of questions for the 21 Questions game. I hope you enjoy them!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 21 Questions Game

text: What should parents stop teaching their children?
followUp: Depending on where the person is in their life, you might find out what they didn't like about their parents or perhaps you'll get a glimpse into the type of parent they would like to be.
sectionContext: Here is our list of questions for the 21 Questions game. I hope you enjoy them!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 21 Questions Game

text: Is it okay to sacrifice one life to save ten?
followUp:
This is straight up an ethics question. You can see how close you both are in your ethical beliefs.

Follow up question: If you said yes, would you change answer if the one life was a friend’s life and the ten were strangers? If no, why not?

The bit about a friend's life is for getting an idea of how much they value their tribe vs. those outside of it.
sectionContext: Here is our list of questions for the 21 Questions game. I hope you enjoy them!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 21 Questions Game

text: How much do you change when you know no one is around?
followUp: We all put on masks for different social situations. Sometimes those masks resemble who we are underneath and sometimes they don't. Hopefully this question will help you get a glimpse of who the person truly is.
sectionContext: Here is our list of questions for the 21 Questions game. I hope you enjoy them!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 21 Questions Game

text: How useful would you be in a zombie apocalypse?
followUp: I just thought this was a fun question. You could get any number of answers that might help you understand more about what kind of person they are. But mostly it's just because it's a fun question to answer.
sectionContext: Here is our list of questions for the 21 Questions game. I hope you enjoy them!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 21 Questions Game

text: How much do you know about the world outside your country?
followUp: This is a great one to see how much they pay attention to the broader world, but it can also be a good gauge of how nationalistic they are. It can also tell you where they think their focus should be, themselves, family, their community, their country, or humanity as a whole.
sectionContext: Here is our list of questions for the 21 Questions game. I hope you enjoy them!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 21 Questions Game

text: Which movie or book do you think is ridiculously overrated?
followUp: Not everyone rides the hype train. Find out more about what they like and if their interests coincide with your own.
sectionContext: Here is our list of questions for the 21 Questions game. I hope you enjoy them!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 21 Questions Game

text: What is something you’ve done that you wish you could undo?
followUp: We all have regrets. With this question you can learn more about what they regret, but also what kind of values they consider important. Because, let's be honest, you probably wouldn't undo something you didn't think was important.
sectionContext: Here is our list of questions for the 21 Questions game. I hope you enjoy them!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 21 Questions Game

text: What is something that can’t be taught and can only be learned with age?
followUp: This will hopefully lead to some thoughtful introspection. How much have they learned from their life so far and how much do they acknowledge the things they still don't know.
sectionContext: Here is our list of questions for the 21 Questions game. I hope you enjoy them!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 21 Questions Game

text: What are the consequences of everyone having instant distraction at their fingertips?
followUp: How addicted to their phones are they? You can find that out. Plus you can find out if they think about how society functions or if they are mostly just focused on themselves.
sectionContext: Here is our list of questions for the 21 Questions game. I hope you enjoy them!
sourceLabel: Conversation Starters World · 21 Questions Game

text: If you could live your life again knowing what you do now, what would you change?
followUp: Similar to the earlier question undoing something in the past, but this one is aimed more at what they have learned from their mistakes. And how they would take advantage of all the knowledge they've gained.
